skill.name: longbridge-earnings
skill.description: Analyze pre-earnings previews and post-earnings updates with Longbridge data. The skill produces lite summary cards or full Markdown research reports for US, Hong Kong, and A-share stocks.
skill.summary: Create earnings previews, summary cards, and full reports from Longbridge market data.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting, financial prose, or related-skill links that are false positives. Confirmed issues are limited to predictable temp-file guidance, an unsanitized temp output path built from the symbol, and fallback command templates that lack validation guidance. No prompt injection attempt or malicious exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: User-controlled symbol affects the collector output directory.
remediation.suggestion: Validate symbols with an allowlist before building paths, reject path separators, and ensure the resolved output path remains under the temp root.

remediation.issue: Reference documentation uses a predictable /tmp/data.json path.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the fixed path with a unique temp file from mktemp or tempfile, and avoid examples that can overwrite existing files.

remediation.issue: Fallback CLI templates do not explain safe handling of user-provided symbols or RAW_DIR paths.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to pass symbols as validated single arguments and avoid interpolating user-controlled values into inline shell commands.

content.value_statement: Earnings work often requires data from reports, consensus, valuation metrics, and recent news. This skill organizes Longbridge data into pre-earnings previews, summary cards, and full Markdown reports.
actual_capabilities: Collects Longbridge CLI data for snapshots, statements, consensus, ratings, news, segments, and price history.
Creates a lite post-earnings summary card with KPI tables, segment revenue, trends, and risks.
Builds full Markdown earnings reports with beat or miss analysis, estimates, valuation, and sources.
Produces pre-earnings previews covering prior guidance, recent events, Q&A themes, and focus points.
Supports US, Hong Kong, and A-share symbols when Longbridge data is available.
limitations: Requires the Longbridge CLI or configured MCP access for primary data.
Full reports may need web search for transcripts and precedent transaction data.
Outputs are research aids and do not replace licensed financial advice.
Some sections are skipped when Longbridge or web data is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Summarize Fresh Results
use_cases.description: Turn a new earnings release into a fast card with metrics, segments, Street view, and risks.

use_cases.title: Build a Full Update
use_cases.description: Create a Markdown research report with estimate changes, valuation methods, and source links.

prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-earnings preview for TSLA.US. Focus on prior guidance, recent events, and key questions.

prompt_templates.title: Full Research Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a full Markdown earnings update for AAPL.US with valuation math and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Custom Thesis Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review NVDA.US after earnings against my thesis: data center growth, margins, and guidance quality. Include estimate revisions and valuation sensitivity.

output: Header with company, quarter, rating, target price, and implied upside.
Core KPI table showing reported results, year-over-year change, and beat or miss status.
Segment revenue, quarterly trend, Street view, next-quarter consensus, and risk tags.

output_examples.input: Create a pre-earnings preview for TSLA.US.
output: Prior guidance versus actual performance from the last reported quarter.
Recent company, industry, macro, and sentiment events tied to the upcoming release.
Key questions, expectation gaps, and risk flags to monitor on results day.

output_examples.input: Generate a full report for AAPL.US.
output: Markdown research report with earnings summary, revenue analysis, margins, guidance, and estimates.
Valuation section using DCF, trading comps, and precedent transactions when relevant.
Sources and references listed as dated Markdown links.

best_practices: Confirm the ticker suffix and market before running the analysis.
Use lite mode first when you need a fast view of a new earnings release.
Request a full report only when valuation math and source links are needed.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing data as zero or fabricate skipped sections.
Do not use this skill for non-earnings initiation reports.
Do not rely on memory when the latest quarter can be fetched.

faq.question: Does this skill make investment recommendations?
faq.answer: It can summarize rating and target price logic, but outputs are research aids, not financial advice.

faq.question: What data sources does it use?
faq.answer: It prioritizes Longbridge CLI or MCP data and supplements with web search for transcripts or missing context.

faq.question: Can it create files?
faq.answer: Yes. Full report mode creates a Markdown report when the user explicitly requests it.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: The workflow covers US, Hong Kong, and A-share symbols when Longbridge data is available.

faq.question: What happens if data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks unavailable sections as not available and continues with the remaining evidence.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
